title: Null safety and strictNullChecks — concept map
intro: strictNullChecks separates null/undefined from other types, optional properties, non-null assertion risks, definite assignment, and comparison to C# nullable reference types.

overviewDiagram.title: strictNullChecks model
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  S[string type] -->|assign null| E[Compile error]
  U[string | null] -->|if x != null| N[Narrowed string]
  EXT[JSON Redis fetch] --> UN[unknown guard]
  UN --> T[Typed value]

conceptCards.title: strictNullChecks
conceptCards.summary: null and undefined not assignable unless in union. Narrow with if, ?., ??.

conceptCards.title: Optional properties
conceptCards.summary: prop?: T includes undefined. exactOptionalPropertyTypes stricter.

conceptCards.title: Non-null assertion !
conceptCards.summary: Tells compiler trust me — no runtime check. Dangerous at boundaries.

conceptCards.title: Definite assignment
conceptCards.summary: strictPropertyInitialization — class fields must be set in constructor.

conceptCards.title: vs C# NRT
conceptCards.summary: Both compile-time only. string vs string?. Runtime null still possible from JSON.
